cases.name: Maria "Ria" Louise Hanian
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "For the past 5 years Maria was employed with the United Sates Post office where she held multiple production positions. Our beloved Ria was a cancer survivor and overcame many health challenges in the last few years including kidney reconstruction surgery. After her health issues it became her goal to live the healthiest life she could. In her free time Ria spent hours working out at the gym, walking, or bicycling.
"
cases.narrative: On 8/19/2021, her body was found at her apartment during a police welfare check.
